key_requirements: GDPR applies: lawful basis, data subject rights, breach notification
research_exemption: Archiving, scientific/historical research and statistics allowed with art. 89 safeguards and minimisation (s. 42); special categories (s. 54); rights restrictions (s. 61); health research regs S.I. 314/2018
genetic_data: GDPR art. 9 special category; genetic testing needs consent; genetic data may not be processed for employment, insurance, pensions or mortgages (Disability Act 2005, s. 42)
